title: Pocketpair (Palworld) gives staff who plan to play GTA VI a special five-day holiday, Thu 19 to Mon 23 Nov 2026 ('an urgent five-day business trip in Vice City'), covering a weekend and Japan's 23 Nov public holiday; CEO Takuro Mizobe takes it too; Logitech gives every employee one 'Logi Game Day' within 12 months; GTA VI unlocks 12:00 am IST Thu 19 Nov in India on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S
